title: Return after an invalid scan
statement: Let $x$ be a binary string such that scanning it from the formula-level state does not end in the exact-end state. Starting the dual transducer in the formula-level scanning state at position $1$ with empty output, the run reaches the anchor state at position $1$ with output consisting of the single bit $0$, after exactly $2|x|+2$ steps. The anchor state is not visited at any earlier time.
hypotheses_covered: The scan of $x$ from formula level does not end in the exact-end state
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary string on which the six-state formula syntax scan from formula
level does not end in the exact-end state. Started in the formula-level scanning state
at head position $1$ with empty output, the dual transducer reaches the anchor state
at position $1$ with output the single bit $0$, in exactly $2|x| + 2$ steps and
without visiting the anchor before then.
